item.title: Connection - Walkthrough
item.description:
Overview

  • Platform: VulNyx
  • Difficulty: Hard
  • OS: Windows
  • Attacker IP: 10.10.10.2
  • Target Machine IP: 10.10.10.12

The objective was to enumerate the target, identify the LFI vulnerability, recover the Administrator’s credentials, and obtain Administrator access through WinRM.

Enumeration

Port Scanning

I started with RustScan to identify exposed ports and running services.

rustscan -a 10.10.10.12 -b 500 -- -sC -sV -A -oN nmap/init
